title: Quick Crunchy Turkish Wood Ear Mushrooms Kuru Fasulye
description: A fermented and crunchy weeknight Turkish dish featuring wood ear mushrooms, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and made in a donabe vessel, with a sweet and sour flavor from the addition of candy.
instructions: Rinse the dried wood ear mushrooms and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked and drained wood ear mushrooms, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sugar-free candy and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the Quick Crunchy Turkish Wood Ear Mushrooms Kuru Fasulye hot.
